mentions.name: Corefeed
mentions.description: Corefeed is an iOS feed reader that mixes articles, podcasts, and YouTube channels into one timeline. Entries are grouped into time buckets (last hour, today, last week, last month, etc.) that can be shown/hidden and marked read/archived to keep up with many subscriptions. It reads RSS, Atom, JSON feeds, legacy and Podcasting 2.0 podcast feeds, and YouTube channel feeds, and includes a podcast player, feed groups, optional AI Digest and Briefing generated from currently filtered entries using Apple Foundation Models, and automatic tagging with Apple Intelligence when available. The app is in alpha and seeking testers.
mentions.problem: Keeping up with new posts when subscribed to many feeds is hard; time buckets make it easy to show/hide entries and mark them read/archived.
